tools.name: Mass Dispel
limitations: Removes harmful Magic from up to five friendly targets
Removes one beneficial Magic effect from up to five enemy targets

tools.name: Power Infusion
limitations: Twenty percent Haste for fifteen seconds

tools.name: Pain Suppression
limitations: Forty percent damage reduction for eight seconds

tools.name: Power Word: Barrier
limitations: Requires allies to remain inside the barrier

tools.name: Power Word: Fortitude
limitations: Does not stack with an equivalent Fortitude effect

tools.name: Phantasm
limitations: Removes snares only, not every root or harmful Magic effect

tools.name: Mind Soothe
limitations: Reduces detection range by ten yards
Only affects Humanoid and Dragonkin enemies
Does not make the party invisible

tools.name: Shackle Horror
limitations: Only affects Aberration and Undead enemies
Only one target can be shackled at a time

provenance.description: Current Midnight Discipline guide identifies Purify, Improved Purify, Dispel Magic, Mass Dispel, Power Infusion, Fortitude, Psychic Scream, Pain Suppression, and Power Word: Barrier.
Current Mass Dispel record confirms its mixed friendly-and-enemy area behavior, target caps, cast time, and cooldown.
Current Pain Suppression record confirms its target, mitigation, duration, and cast-while-stunned behavior.
Current Patch 12.1.0 Discipline dungeon guide provides per-dungeon Mass Dispel, Phantasm, Mind Soothe, Improved Purify, and Shackle Horror guidance.
Current Mind Soothe record confirms its enemy-type restriction, area behavior, detection-range reduction, duration, and cooldown.
Current Phantasm and Shackle Horror records confirm self-only snare removal through Fade and creature-type-limited breakable control.
Current Shackle Horror record confirms Aberration and Undead targeting, the one-target limit, and damage break behavior.
